description: Boundary coverage for target-URL forwarding: the wrapper must forward whatever target string the caller supplied verbatim, including degenerate or non-ASCII targets, and must keep targeting the identical destination across a deeper chain of retried attempts. Observing the most recently issued request after several transient failures confirms the target is never rewritten between attempts.
